ios.desc:
Pocket: the simplest way to use private LLMs. It works fully offline and ensures your privacy when you don’t have an internet connection. Pocket runs models on-device, optimized for Apple Silicon to provide fast and efficient performance.
Run powerful AI models like Llama, Gemma, and Qwen directly on your iPhone and iPad. Completely offline. 100% private. No accounts, no logins, and zero data collection. Your data never leaves your device.

Personalize your experience: adjust the theme, fonts, and system prompt directly within the app to match your preferences.

With Pocket's shortcut integration, you can easily chat with your local model or get an output to use with other actions, all while keeping everything local and secure.

Free, local, private — your data stays on your device, always.
Pocket supports a wide range of models to cater to various needs, including the following language models:

Llama 3 2 1B 4bit
Llama 3 2 3B 4bit
Llama 3 8B 4bit
Mistral 7B Instruct 02
Mistral 7B v02 4bit
Phi 4bit
Gemma 2 2B IT 4bit
Gemma 2 9B IT 4bit
Gemma 2B Quantized
OpenELM 270M 4bit
Qwen 3
Deepseek

Whether you're working on text generation, language processing, or complex tasks, Pocket has a model for you.
In addition to language models, Pocket also supports image models for users who want to generate visual content. With just a few taps, users can switch between text and image models, creating everything from written outputs to images—all processed locally on your device.

Customization is key: you can easily choose a new model or switch between existing ones within the app. Whether you’re switching between models to experiment with different capabilities or looking for specific output types, Pocket gives you full control.

With the ability to generate images when desired, Pocket can assist in visual projects alongside text-based tasks. All of this is done securely and privately, ensuring no data is stored or shared outside the app.
